text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Nozomi had been hiding the fact that she has a fetish for smells. However, due to the effects of the "elixir that releases your true self" developed by Louise Marie, she was no longer able to suppress her fetish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自身が匂いフェチであることを隠し続けていたノゾミ。
ルイズマリーの開発した『本当の自分を解放する秘薬』の効果で
その体質を抑えられなくなってしまった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: While still being very sensitive to smells, she started her work as a one-day manager at the shop...
text_block_list.orig_text: 匂いに敏感なまま迎えた、一日店長の仕事──

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Please, {0}-kun. Stay over ten meters away. If you don't, I'll end up going berserk again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い、
{0}くん。
10ｍ以上離れててね。
そうじゃないと私、
やっぱり暴走しちゃうみたい。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I have to be careful not to go out of control while I'm working. I need to take deep breaths so I don't get nervous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事中に、
暴走しないように気を付けなくっちゃ。
緊張しないように
深呼吸……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: HAWAAAAHHHH... No good, I can't hold back!! *sniff sniff*...♪ Hafuu...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はわぁああ……
ダメだ
我慢できないっ！！
クンクンクン……♪　
はふぅ……♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: N-NO SHAMELESS BEHAVIOUR ALLOWED!! LET GO OF HIM!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
破廉恥禁止よーっ！！
離れなさーい！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Lou-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえ、
ルイちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: We're on name basis already?!
text_block_list.orig_text: もう名前呼び！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: You called it a "secret elixir that releases your true self", didn't you? I do have a smell fetish, but... It shouldn't have been this bad.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『本当の自分を解放する秘薬』
って言ったよね。
確かに私、
匂いフェチだけど……
……
こんなにひどくはなかったはずなんだけどな。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Well, this is just my speculation here, but it seems like the symptoms are about 100 times worse than normally expected. Apparently my elixir was too succesful, it simply worked TOO well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ま、
憶測だけど
本来の100倍くらいの症状が出ちゃってるっぽいわね。
成功しすぎて効き目が良すぎたみたい。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That's... that's plainly put a failure. It amplified the expected results of releasing someone's inner self.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ
失敗っていうんだけどな。
解放通り越して
増幅しちゃってるわけでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, Lou-chan... can you make me a potion or elixir that will return me to normal?! If things stay like this, I don't know if I can continue being an idol...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
ねえルイちゃん……
元に戻る薬って
作ってもらえないかな！？
このままだと私、
アイドルも続けられるかどうか……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I've no idea. You took it on your own, didn't you? You ruined someone else's elixir, geez...
text_block_list.orig_text:
知らないわよ
あなたが勝手に飲んだんでしょ？
人の薬ダメにしといて
まったく……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm really sorry about that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう
う……っ。
それは本当にごめんなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, wait a sec. Isn't it noisier outside the store? There's still some time before opening time, right...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っと、
待った。
店の方が騒がしくない？　
まだ開店時間まであるわよね……？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's with this huge line? There's a huge crowd of people on the street in front of the store and I can't get outside. Someone has to get this line in order... Lou-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
なにこれ
すっごい行列。
店の前の道
人だかりで身動きできなくなってるじゃん。
とりま列整理してこなくちゃ。
ルイちゃんが。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: You want ME to do it?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 私がやるんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: So many customers have come...! Okay, I'll put my own needs aside. Time to get fired up...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客さん、
こんなにたくさん来てくれてるんだ……！
よ
し、
自分のことは後回し。
気合入れるよ……っ！

text_block_list.name: Customer 1
text_block_list.text: Who would have thought that Nozomin would come to a place like this! I wonder what she'll be doing as manager for a day? I'm looking forward to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミンがこんなところに来てくれるなんて！
しかも一日店長って何やるんだろう？　
楽しみだな～！

text_block_list.name: Customer 2
text_block_list.text: I hope they'll open soon! I couldn't wait ever since I saw the flyer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
早く開店してくれないかな～
チラシを見た時から
待ちきれなくってさ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Lou-chan, Sono-chan. Are you ready to open up shop? Well then, let's open up and start!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイちゃん、
ソノちゃん。
開店準備、
いいかな？　
それじゃあお店、開けるね！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Everyone~♪ One-day Manager of the Alkes Alchemy Hall, Nozomi's here! Thanks for coming today~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな～♪
アルケス錬金堂
一日店長のノゾミだよ～！
今日は来てくれてありがと～♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WHOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!! NOZOMIIIIIIIINNNNNNNNNN!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおおおお～～～っ！！
ノゾミーーーン！！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: NWAH! Th-There's so many people and so much energy...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ
すごい人の数と熱気……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Customer 1
text_block_list.text: Are they selling Nozomin's related good here today?! I'm so happy! Then I'll buy lots!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はノゾミンから商品を渡してもらえるの！？
うれしい、
じゃあたくさん買っちゃおーっと！

text_block_list.name: Customer 1
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? But there's no merchandise on the shelf... What kind of store is this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？　
でも
棚に商品ないけど……
ここって何屋さん？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Fufu. We're the Alkes Alchemy Hall. We are a shop that can make any product using Lou's alchemy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
うちはアルケス錬金堂。
ルイちゃんの錬金術で、
どんな商品でも作っちゃうお店です。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...I see! So that's what you meant when you said you're a shop that "has everything"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほど！
無いものは無いお店ってそういう事なんだ！

text_block_list.name: Customer 1
text_block_list.text: Huh? "Anything"...? Th-Then, maybe I could buy some Nozomin goods that nobody has!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
なんでも……？
じゃ、
じゃあ
誰も持ってない
ノゾミングッズとか
買えちゃったり！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh...?! T-That kind of thing is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……！？
さ、
さすがにそれは……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: You can... Anyway, I'm counting on you, Lou-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あるよ。
……
ってことで、
頼んだルイちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: *sigh* Fine. Just wait a minute.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
分かったわよ。
ちょっと待ってて。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: "Original Transmutation"!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『基創錬成』！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Here you go. It's an exclusive Nozomi-san figure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいどうぞ。
ノゾミさんフィギュアよ。

text_block_list.name: Customer 1
text_block_list.text: Wow, what amazing quality!! Nozomin's face and body figure are perfect♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
わああっ、
すごいクオリティ！！
顔もスタイルも
完璧にノゾミンよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Customer 2
text_block_list.text: A Nozomin alarm clock... do you have it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミン目覚まし時計
ありますか！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: They have
text_block_list.orig_text: あるよ。

text_block_list.name: Customer 3
text_block_list.text: W-Well then, I'll have the Nozomin thigh pillow! I'm sure you have one, right!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
じゃあオレは
ノゾミン太もも枕！
きっとあるよな！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: They have
text_block_list.orig_text: あるよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: NO WE DO NOT!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 無いです！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, the Alkes Alchemist Hall business was booming. The line of customers continued unabated, and three hours later...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして大盛況のアルケス錬金堂。
客の列は途切れることなく、そして３時間後。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... This is getting overbearing to handle. What's going on with that girl? She's so popular... It's like we've turned into an idol shop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
ちょっと忙しすぎなんだけど。
どうなってんのよあの人の人気……
もはやアイドルショップよこれじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Putting that aside, I have to let that girl take a break. I-It's not like I'm worried or anything like that, but... Even if she's here just for a day, I still don't want my manager to collapse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはともかく
あの人にも休憩取らせなくちゃ。
べっ、
別に心配とかじゃないけど……
一日とはいえ
うちの店長がぶっ倒れたら困るから。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Fufu. What kind of tsundere act even is that? Let us go too, {0}-kun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
どういう方向のツンデレよ。
{0}君。
私たちも行こう。

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WHOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAA!! NOZOMIIIINNNNNNNNNN!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおおおお～～～っ！！
ノゾミ～～～ン！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: WHEEEEE?! There are even more customers?! The store is packed... Surely even Nozomi-san is going to be bothered by this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！？　
さらにお客さんが増えてる！？
お店の中ぎゅうぎゅうじゃないの……
これじゃさすがのノゾミさんも音をあげて……

text_block_list.name: ノゾミ
text_block_list.text:
はあ……♪
一人ひとり、
みんなのうれしい気持ちがまじりあって、
まるで楽しさの花束みたいな匂い……
はあ、
好きぃ……♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……♪
一人ひとり、
みんなのうれしい気持ちがまじりあって、
まるで楽しさの花束みたいな匂い……
はあ、
好きぃ……♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: SHE'S BOTHERED IN A TOTALLY DIFFERENT VECTOR!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 違うベクトルで大丈夫じゃなかった！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. ...Wait a minute. If you get too close to her...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
そうだね。
……
ってか
待って。
君が近づいたら……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: HAWAH...!? THIS IS {0}-KUN'S SMELLLLL...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はわぁ……！？
{0}くんの匂いぃぃ……♪

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Wait, you have to be at least 10 meters away...! {0}-kun, run away for now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょー、
10ｍ以上離れてなきゃ駄目だって……！
{0}君とりま逃げといて！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaiiiit~♪ {0}-kun~♪

text_block_list.name: Customer 1
text_block_list.text: Eh... Nozomin? What are you doing? Why is Nozomin looking at that man with an expression of ecstasy...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ……
ノゾミンどういうこと？
ノゾミンが
恍惚の表情で
あの男を……？

text_block_list.name: Customer 2
text_block_list.text: Nozomin...? W-W-Was that j-j-just a hallucination of m-m-mine...? T-T-This seems a b-b-bit hard to believe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミン……？
今のは
俺の幻覚か……？　
ちょっと
信じがたい光景だったんだが？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops, this is bad. I wonder how we should hide this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おっと
これやばいわよ。
どうやって誤魔化したもんかな……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Sono-san, buy us 30 seconds!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ソノさん、
30秒だけ時間稼いで！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: DORYARYAAAAHHHHHH!! "ORIGINAL TRANSMUTATION"!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どりゃりゃ～～～っ！！
『基創錬成』～～～っ！！！

text_block_list.name: ノゾミ
text_block_list.text:
はあ……
ふふ。
{0}くん、捕まえた～♪
じゃあ
匂い、
いただきま～す……♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
ふふ。
{0}くん、捕まえた～♪
じゃあ
匂い、
いただきま～す……♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Hey you!!! NO SHAMELESSNESS ALLOWED!! {0}-kun, let her wear this!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こらーっ！！！　
破廉恥禁止ーっ！！
{0}くん、
これ
その子に装着させて！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Am I...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ、
私また……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, even though you're right in front of me, I can't smell anything at all. ...Maybe it's because of this mask.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん、
キミが目の前にいるのに、
全然匂いがしないよ。
……このマスクのおかげなのかな。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It protects against deadly poisons, too, so it's a "gas mask(unexpectedly, a cloth type)". As expected of Lou's alchemy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
猛毒も防ぐ、
『ガスマスク
（まさかの布タイプ）』
だっけ。
さすがルイちゃんの錬金術だ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Isn't it a good thing that you hurried up and quickly made it for Nozomi-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミちゃんのために
急いで作ってあげるなんて、
いいとこあんじゃん？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...It's not like that. I just want to stop {0}-kun from being subject to more shameless acts from her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そんなんじゃないわ。
これ以上
{0}くん相手に、
破廉恥行為させないためよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Is that so?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
さいですかー

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, with this mask on, I'll be fine! I can work hard as a manager until the day's over!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よしっ、
このマスクがあれば大丈夫！
最後まで一日店長頑張れるよ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, with the help of Louise Marie's alchemy items, Nozomi somehow managed to finish her day as a store manager without any problems, however...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてルイズマリーの錬金アイテムの助けもあり、
なんとか無事に一日店長を終えたノゾミだが──

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Wow, we racked up a ton of sales. I think we can make a living from this for a while. ...It's all thanks to you, Nozomi-chan. From tomorrow, I'll frame a photo of you into an altar and worship it daily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うひょー、
すごい売り上げ。
これで当分は食べていけそう。
……
これもすべて
ノゾミちゃんのおかげね。
明日からノゾミちゃんのブロマイド
額に入れて拝むことにするわ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: No, no, I'm just glad I was able to help. A lot of things happened and I've caused you trouble, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえいえ、
お役に立てたなら良かった。
色々迷惑をかけちゃったりもしたけど……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Lou-chan, thank you so much for this mask. You really saved me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ルイちゃん、
このマスクありがとう。
本当に助かったよ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: It's nothing. Well, I'll give it to you as a thank you for today. Now, I think I'll go take a shower. Good work today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に。
ま、
今日のお礼にそれはあげるわ。
じゃ、
私はそろそろシャワー浴びてこようかしら。
お疲れさまー

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
待って……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Continuing our conversation this morning... It was careless of me to take your elixir, and I'm really not in a position to ask for something like this... But I wonder if there's a medicine that can cure this situation of my nose being too sensitive!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今朝の話の続き……
薬を飲んじゃったのは私の不注意だし、
ホント、
こんなこと頼める立場じゃないんだけど……
鼻が利き過ぎるこの状況、
治す薬って
作れないかな！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I-If you need money I have it, don't worry! I'll even pay you my entire salary for my next live tour if that's what it takes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もちろんお金なら払うよ！
次のライブツアーのお給料、
全額支払ったっていいから……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Money isn't the issue here. Besides, it's not like I'm doing this out of spite and refusing to make it for you. ...I'm just not sure if I'd be able to properly create it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別にお金の話じゃないわ。
それに
意地悪で作ってあげないなんてこともない。
……単純に
作れるか分かんないのよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: The materials used for it are very rare, and even if you can get them, it's uncertain whether I can make it properly or not... even with the skills of a genius like myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
素材も希少なものを使うでしょうし、
素材が手に入ったとしても
うまく作れるかどうか……
この天才の技術を持ってしてもね。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: A medicine that can reverse something is much harder to make than you think.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにかを元に戻す薬って、
想像より
ずっと大変なの。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I see... I was selfish... I'm so sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだ……
自分勝手だね、
ごめん。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hey, Nozomi-chan. If it's okay with you, why don't you come work for us for a while, without this whole "manager for a day" thing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのさ、
ノゾミちゃん。
もしよかったら、
一日店長とは言わず、
しばらく
うちで働いてくれない？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: If you remain here with us, it'll be easy to get information on the materials we need, and if anything happens to you, we should be able to deal with it right away. Lou-chan will. Honestly, you being here makes things sell like hotcakes and if you stay a lil'more... it'll be godly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここにいれば素材の情報も入りやすいし、
なにかあればすぐに対処できるだろうしさ。
ルイちゃんが。
ぶっちゃけ
爆売れウハウハ状態、
もうちょっと続けば
神だし。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Don't be so selfish with your desires, Sono-san. Isn't this girl a popular idol? I'm sure she'll be busy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝手な事言わないでよソノさん。
この人アイドルなんでしょ？　
きっと忙しいわよ。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: No, she can stay until our next live show that's scheduled in two weeks from now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや。
二週間後のライブツアーまでなら都合をつけられるぞ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Producer! Did you come to check on me? You look kind of worn out tough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
プロデューサー！
様子を見に来てくれたんですか？
って
なんだかボロボロですけど……

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Heh. It's been a while since I've danced so hard that my blood boiled. I got a little excited and got serious, but... Iroha, if it's you I'm up against, I'll play a game of life and death anytime☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
フッ。
久々に血沸き肉躍るダンスをな。
つい盛り上がって本気になってしまったが……
イロハ、
オマエ相手なら
いつでも命のやりとりに興じよう☆

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That was fun, Big Sis Chris! Let's play one-on-one duel to the death again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははっ！
楽しかったねクリスおねーちゃん！
また対決ごっこしよーねー！

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha☆ Ahahahhaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
「ハーハッハッハッハ☆」
「あははははーっ！」

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: They're really hitting it off...
text_block_list.orig_text: めっちゃ意気投合してる……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ummm, Producer, are you sure I can work here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
プロデューサー
ここで働いてもいいんですか？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Yeah. If you don't heal that condition, you won't be able to let go of the mask either, right? Idols can't hide their faces forever, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
その体質を治さないと
マスクが手放せないんだろう？
アイドルがいつまでも顔を隠すわけにもいかないからな。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: So with that said, Iroha's friends☆ Take good care of Nozomi for me, okay? Then I'm counting on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
と
いう訳で、
イロハの仲間ども☆
しっかりノゾミの面倒を見てやってくれよ？
では頼んだっ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Producer's seal of approval's here...!
text_block_list.orig_text: プロデューサーのお墨付きキター！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Nozomi-chan you're going to stay with us?! You're Big Sis Chris's friend, so I like you too~♪ Hey, hey, let's take a bath together~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミちゃんいてくれるの！？
クリスおねーちゃんのお友だちだから
ノゾミちゃんも好き～♪
ねね、
一緒にお風呂入ろ～♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: H-Hey don't just go on ahead and approve this! I didn't say I'd agree...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
勝手に進めないでよ！
私は了承なんて……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I-It can't be helped then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しょ、
しょうがないわね……

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: So easy.
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょろっ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In order to cure the changes in her constitution caused by the secret elixir, Nozomi began working at the Alkes Alchemist Hall.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして薬で変わってしまった体質を治すため、
ノゾミはアルケス錬金堂で働くことになったのだった。
